findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 5
Raise: Data loss
Case: normal use - A finished worktree has a test-modified `uv.lock`, so ordinary removal fails. Forge checks its status again in `src/forge/task.py:957`, then force-removes it. If a developer saves another file after that status snapshot, the forced removal deletes the edit without another check. The ordinary removal at `src/forge/doctor.py:177` has the same gap for a newly created ignored file such as `.env`: [Git checks ordinary status before removing the directory](https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.47.0/builtin/worktree.c#L1169-L1275), which does not include ignored files. The new test writes before the first removal and does not exercise either window.
